author: child_resource_debugger
rationale: The actual ObjectAdmittedRangeResult child-certificate closure returned official verify0/artifact, but max rose0→6325 and strict resource acceptance failed. Its100 process receipts lack time/PID/memory evidence. Localizing the actual proof-path resource cost is necessary before proposing a justified remedy for pure LexLean UOR-R4. Full PrismPM and Pages remain unfinished. This is one observability experiment, NOT a qualification rerun, equivalent-limit success retry, benchmark or generic harness.
question: In what bounded intervals does max increase, and which owned compile/checker/audit/probe processes are observed across those intervals?
whyBoundaryOnlyInsufficient: Immediately-before/after-verify samples can separate verification from surrounding work but cannot distinguish phases inside264.017s. Boundary samples and bounded process correlation must occur in the SAME single diagnostic; no pilot positive or automatic repeat.

target.inputs: All50 pinned expected-input destination/hash/length entries unchanged; same33-module closure and generated development-lock bytes/hash.
target.limits: Unchanged4GiB container,2CPU,5GiB VM, network none, no mounts.
target.timeout: Pinned limits.child_timeout_ms=300000 is a per-child timeout, not evidence of a300s whole-verify limit. Preserve it; add no outer kill timer, extension or observer cancellation.
target.acceptance: All original identity/storage/epoch/idle guards and strict absolute-all-zero memory.events pre/post gates remain intact. Diagnostic deltas never substitute for acceptance.

preconditions: No implementation or execution is authorized here. A later one-off reader implementation requires independent source/pre-run review and explicit top-session authority.

Independent reviewer must inspect exact source/tools, observation code/buffers/quotas, ownership filters, clock semantics, placement/overhead, fresh reserves and full launch/postcapture order. Approval is diagnostic only.

Separately authorized fresh resource epoch with six absolute counters0 is required. Current nonzero epoch cannot pass existing precheck. This proposal grants no restart/reset/epoch-preparation authority. Preserve old epoch identity, artifacts, receipts and failure history; retain separate new epoch evidence.

Remeasure original host/guest storage reserve gates. Require exclusive target-container ownership and recorded absence of concurrent SDK/compiler work. Any overlap, drift or failed preflight blocks launch. Never inspect other labs.

Reviewer must verify available read-only cgroup/process interfaces and observer bounds before launch. Prefer one reader outside measured cgroup only if already authorized access permits without VM/config/SDK changes. Do not assume availability. If inside, record observer PID/start-time/RSS and acknowledge pressure as a confound; never subtract it from acceptance.
At most ONE official positive verification. No blind rerun, pilot positive, automatic fallback, repeat or qualification promotion.

capture.clock: Bracket each batch with monotonic start/end and one wall-clock anchor. Reads are non-atomic; record missed ticks with no catch-up bursts.
capture.cadence: Target100ms: full keyed memory.events, memory.current, memory.swap.current and memory.peak if supported. Every5s and at launcher boundaries: full keyed memory.stat, memory.pressure and memory.events.local if available. Preserve unknown keys; mark unsupported files. Never reset peaks or counters. Apply existing output quotas, recording any incomplete read.
capture.processes: Each tick records live owned lexlean/lean/leanchecker PID+start-time ticks, PPID, argv class/module, VmRSS and VmHWM. Verify target-cgroup membership and diagnostic invocation ancestry; include observer explicitly. Missing/exited/raced PIDs are gaps. No environment reads or other-container/lab processes.
capture.reader: One bounded observer uses direct /proc/cgroup reads; no new docker/ps/helper per sample. Store bounded argv identity once per PID+start-time, with compact identity references on samples. Overlong argv becomes incomplete/unknown. This is a product-specific one-off, not reusable infrastructure.

classes.compile: lean argv with generated lean-src/LexLeanR4 path and -o generated olean.
classes.unknown: outer orchestration, vanished/unrecognized process or unresolved overlap; never force classification.

boundaries: Before/after staging/lock/check, and immediately before verify.
Verify start/return; immediate resource sample on return BEFORE artifact-copy.
Artifact-copy start/end if ordinary workflow retains it; immediate post-copy sample.
capture.copyLimit: Copy markers distinguish intervals only. Do NOT assume Docker artifact-copy memory is charged to target cgroup or caused old max increment.
capture.preserve: Retain official stdout/stderr/results/artifact/process/kernel receipts unchanged and add observations in a NEW owned root. Rehash source/tool identities before and after. Never edit old evidence.

output.scope: Total NEW observation trace, identity dictionary, markers and summary. Normal compiler receipts/artifact remain separately retained: prior artifact8399075bytes cannot fit a1MiB cap on all official output.
output.behavior: Fixed bounded buffers, no overwrite/ring loss. On any quota exhaustion stop ONLY observation, preserve bytes and emit trace_truncated/coverage bounds using reserved summary. Let healthy compiler and original postguards finish. No unobserved attribution.

inferenceRules: Positive max delta localizes events only between consecutive read bounds, not an exact instant. Correlate all observed process identities across that interval.
A sole stable process across samples supports overlap, not sole allocation causality. Shared cache/background activity and observer overhead remain possible.

Identity changes, overlapping workers, short-lived missed PIDs, read races, missed ticks or trace cap mean ambiguous interval. No culprit inferred from longest duration, source size, file mtimes or assumed tool order.
VmHWM is per-process historical RSS; available memory.peak is cgroup/epoch high water. Neither yields a timed continuous peak curve. Do not sum process peaks.
Same sources/tools/limits do not imply same cache/memory/stage history. Preserve epoch and warm-state differences; old-versus-new is not a controlled allocation comparison.

memory.events is hierarchical. max records attempted boundary exceedance; reclaim may avert OOM. RSS alone does not account for cgroup charges. Full keyed memory.stat supplies anon/file/kernel context without assigning a culprit. Optional local counters distinguish scope only.

findingsAndUnlocks.unlock: Static review of that actual generated proof/source/import/serialization cost; separately formulate a falsifiable hypothesis. No immediate source fix.
Inspect corresponding retained olean/audit source/import closure and tool path. No replacement SDK, skipped audit or omitted module.

findingsAndUnlocks.finding: max0 immediately after verify, later increase.
findingsAndUnlocks.unlock: Falsifies verify-only attribution for this diagnostic. Review surrounding processes/cgroup activity; does not prove Docker-copy charging.
Investigate observed earlier interval; do not blame verification for first increment. Existing gates still govern launch and result.
Only non-reproduction in observed new state. Original failure remains; no qualification/control promotion or automatic second run.

findingsAndUnlocks.finding: Ambiguous overlap, observer pressure, gaps or output cap.
findingsAndUnlocks.unlock: Insufficient attribution. Preserve evidence. Another diagnostic requires a new concrete proposal/review, not continuation by default.

healthyCompiler: Observer exhaustion/failure or observed max increments must NOT interrupt healthy compiler. Preserve existing SDK300000ms child timeout and behavior; add no signals, suspension, reprioritization, kill timer or extension. Complete non-interfering capture/postguards and report resource failure separately.

reference.provenance: Parent independently checked primary documentation; supplied memory.events semantics and memory.stat context. This agent made no network call.
reference.use: Counter interpretation only, never allocation attribution.
